Captured in a fresh 30-day Developer scratch org, deleted and deletion verified. A synthetic Customer Community profile had API Enabled. Its assigned permission set granted Case Read, Create and Edit but not Delete, Subject and Origin read/edit access, and access to the deployed pages, controllers and proxy classes. An attempt to grant Status field access was rejected. The page action performed user-mode Case insert, update and delete, then exposed the outcome in an output component. The authenticated Community user invoked an Apex REST proxy which requested that page with PageReference.getContent; the returned rendered output is recorded here. The project contains the exact pages and controllers; transport contains the exact proxy classes. Class and page metadata declare the observed API versions.
